messages:
nina.k: Quick bulletin for managers + eng leads — small but important updates to supplier onboarding and p-card rules. Full doc here (1-min skim): https://redwood.internal/finance/supplier-update :link:

nina.k: Highlights:
- Micro-vendor path: one-off suppliers under $3,000 total cost can use the fast-track (no legal), but finance still needs W-9 + PO.
- Recurring/ARR threshold: any forecasted recurring spend >= $18,000/year now triggers the full vendor questionnaire and contract review (was $25k).
- P-card temporary cap for trial SaaS raised to $1,200 (manager note required). Anything expected to become recurring >$4k/yr must go through procurement.
- Equipment for contractors: single receipts > $1,000 require pre-approval. If urgent, add `EXPEDITE-HIRE` in the form and tag @finance for same-day triage.

devon_h: Quick clarification  is the $3k micro-vendor limit per purchase or per vendor per fiscal year?

nina.k: It's per engagement/purchase. If the same vendor is used repeatedly and hits $3k in aggregate in a fiscal year, we'll reclassify them as a vendor and require onboarding. Managers should note expected cadence in the request.

oscar_t: We have a contractor needing laptop+monitor ~ $1,350 and the vendor is new. Which form?

nina.k: Submit the `contractor-equipment` form, mark hardware and tag @people-ops + @finance. Because it's >$1k and vendor is new we'll collect onboarding docs (W-9, bank routing) while triaging. Use `EXPEDITE-HIRE` if start date <48h.

procure-bot: Vendor request created: id=V-2026-7773, submitted by oscar_t, amount est. $1,350. Status: awaiting finance intake.

devon_h: For SaaS bought on p-card during hackweek ($1,150) that later converts to a $6k/yr plan, what's the retro process?

nina.k: Escalate within 5 business days via the vendor-retrospective form. Procurement will reconcile charges and open vendor onboarding if annualized spend >$4k. We'll also check for data access or SSO requirements and may ask legal.

oscar_t: One more  any auto-flagging in the procurement portal for vendors that handle PII? Can we pre-flag to speed up legal review?

nina.k: Yes  the portal auto-flags vendors that request data ingestion or have cloud storage scopes. When in doubt, add `DATA-ACCESS` in the justification and legal will prioritize review.

devon_h: Will there be a manager cheat-sheet? Our leads will DM us non-stop otherwise. :sweat_smile:

nina.k: Yep  publishing a one-page cheat-sheet + a couple of examples (contractor monitor, small SaaS trial, one-off consultant) to #general and the finance docs by EOD. If you want training for your team, ping @people-ops and we'll set up a 15-min drop-in. :sparkles:
